campaign.banner: Early Black Friday – 50% off everything, up to 60% off

hooks: Black Friday prices are live now. No need to wait.
Early Black Friday: up to sixty percent off.
Why wait for Black Friday? The prices are already live.
facts: Early Black Friday Sale: live now (from 23 October), it runs until 30 November (Cyber Monday). Black Friday is 27 November.
50% off everything sitewide (each bag's own % is on its offer card: the Hobo Bag is 50% off).
Up to 60% off: some bundles are 60% off, like the Hobo Bag 3-Piece Set. Say '60% off' only of the 3-Piece Set (or another named bundle), never of a single bag or of 'any 2 bags'.
No free gifts and no extra cart discount: both were removed by the owner on 26 October.
The Hobo Bag's product page offers the 3-Piece Set as the 'Best Value' upgrade.
Black Friday prices are live now: no need to wait.

Sale items are final sale: they cannot be returned (the site's Black Friday terms); faulty items are still covered and the 1-year warranty still applies. Never say 'easy returns', 'free returns' or 'send it back' in a Black Friday ad.

Christmas delivery (the site's Black Friday terms, filled in by 27 October): order by 14 December 2026 for the best chance of delivery before Christmas; delivery before Christmas is not guaranteed, so say 'the best chance', never 'guaranteed by Christmas'.
campaign.client_ideas: Owner 2026-10-26: everything is on sale everywhere, so stand out; the Hobo Bag page upsells the 3-Piece Set ('Best Value'): ads that sell the set raise the order value; 'Black Friday prices are live now, no need to wait'; Christmas gifting (mum, sister, best friend); 2 straps on the Hobo 2.0 (handbag + crossbody); in the last week: Black Friday 27 November, Cyber Monday 30 November, 'last chance'. The AI ads 'seem to be starting to work: keep testing'.

primary: Early Black Friday is live: 50% off everything, and up to 60% off bundles like the 3-Piece Set.

campaign.approved: Wouter (owner), 2026-10-23: the Black Friday Sale went live on 23 October and runs until 30 November (Cyber Monday). Up to 50% off sitewide; 60% off bundles (2 or 3 bags bought together at 60% off the regular price); free gifts while stocks last: buy 2 bags, get a free mirrored jewellery box (worth $19.95); buy 3+ bags, get the jewellery box + a free cosmetic bag (together worth $44.90); only bags count, not accessories. The site banner (2026-10-23): 'EARLY BLACK FRIDAY: 50% OFF EVERYTHING | BUY 2 BAGS = 1 FREE GIFT | BUY 3 = 2 FREE GIFTS | ORDER TODAY WHILE STOCKS LAST!' | UPDATE Wouter (owner), 2026-10-26: the free gifts and the extra cart discount on bags are removed ('they're not coming back'); 'It's 50% OFF or you can say up to 60% OFF'; 60% is only on bundles 'like the 3 piece set', not any 2 bags; the site now has Early Black Friday messaging, a countdown in the announcement bar, 'Ships by' and delivery dates, and the 3-Piece Set as a 'Best Value' upgrade on the Hobo Bag page; during Black Friday no returns are accepted (final sale).
